decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any flank wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The detached single storey outbuilding hereby found permitted shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse known as 74 Wellesley Road, W4 3AL and for no other purpose.
description: Erection of single storey detached studio building in rear garden to house.
